scope: Multi-package manager publishing (pnpm, yarn, bun), pre-release distribution tagging (alpha/beta), and final pre-release validation audit

tasks.title: Build Multi-Package-Manager CI/CD Publish Workflow
tasks.description: Create a unified GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/publish.yml) triggered on GitHub release events and workflow_dispatch. Set up Node.js, Bun, pnpm, and Yarn environments, configure NPM registry authentication via NPM_TOKEN, verify package tarball contents, and establish automated package verification and publishing across pnpm, yarn, bun, and npm.

tasks.title: Configure Dynamic Alpha and Beta Tag Routing in Release Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement automated tag parsing logic in the workflow triggered upon GitHub Release creation (or tag push). Detect semantic pre-release identifiers from the release tag or version string (e.g., v*.*.*-alpha.* -> npm dist-tag 'alpha', v*.*.*-beta.* -> npm dist-tag 'beta', otherwise default to 'latest'). Publish using the resolved distribution tag (--tag alpha, --tag beta, or --tag latest) across package managers and generate GitHub release verification summaries.

tasks.title: Final Pre-Release Audit, Verification & Manifest Synchronization
tasks.description: Execute complete pre-release checks prior to publishing: ensure all unit/integration tests pass cleanly, verify package.json (version bump, files whitelist, main/module/types exports, scripts), validate TypeScript declarations (index.d.ts), audit CHANGELOG.md, build docs site assets, run npm pack dry-run to ensure no unwanted scratch/test artifacts are packaged, and synchronize workspace status in .agent/.
